# TIA Enterprise Portal & Mobile App
> Tirupati Intellect Authority - Empowering Tirupati with AI, Mechatronics, and Cloud Systems. Led by Founder & CEO M. Bhargav Rayudu (B.Tech Mechatronics • CAD Diploma), GSTIN 37EYLPM8018M1ZN.

## Core Services
- [TIA Enterprise Portal](https://tia-tirupati-intellect-authority.onrender.com/): Official enterprise workstation, executive attendance, payslips, communications, and multi-file code studio.
- [TIA Mobile App Download](https://tia-tirupati-intellect-authority.onrender.com/download/app): Official cross-platform mobile PWA installation and desktop application package.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery Catalog](https://tia-tirupati-intellect-authority.onrender.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Standard machine-readable AI agent capability manifest.
- [System Sitemap](https://tia-tirupati-intellect-authority.onrender.com/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML sitemap for automated indexing.

## Capabilities
- [Executive Attendance System](https://tia-tirupati-intellect-authority.onrender.com/#attendance): Geolocation-verified punch-in, work hours logging, and executive verification.
- [AI Code Forge](https://tia-tirupati-intellect-authority.onrender.com/#code-runner): Browser-based code runner and terminal emulator for JavaScript, Python, C, C++, and Web systems.
- [Automated Payslip Engine](https://tia-tirupati-intellect-authority.onrender.com/#payslips): Automated monthly salary slips, tax deductions, and printable enterprise vouchers.
- [Executive Communications](https://tia-tirupati-intellect-authority.onrender.com/#communications): Real-time priority messaging connecting CEO, CMO, PM, and Engineering leads.
